# The compose small-message threshold applies to byte updates, not every taskbar signal

In onProgressChange, positive totals always update the compose meter, but taskbar byte updates require aMaxTotalProgress greater than 65536. Unknown totals clear taskbar progress. The current start callback separately sends STATE_NORMAL with zero current and maximum values. Stop sends STATE_NO_PROGRESS before the terminal observer. A small message can therefore still produce start and clear signals; the current mocked small-send test expects three events. Keep start, byte and stop phases separate when describing or testing this threshold. Static source only; no native taskbar or send test ran.

Scope: Compose taskbar progress phases.
